name: School Girl Domination ~Kyonyuu JK ga Chika Joshi Wrestler ni Natta Riyuu~
original_name: School Girl Domination ～巨乳JKが地下女子レスラーになった理由～
source:
Nagisa becomes head of the pro wrestling club when the senior members retire.
She was living an ordinary schoolgirl life,
until circumstances led her to join an underground wrestling ring.

She nervously awaits the day of her debut bout,
only to discover that her opponent is the girl she faced two years ago,
who beat her by knock-out.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE264204.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
前辈们退部后，Nagisa接任了职业摔跤社社长。
她原本过着普通女学生的生活，
却因种种缘由，踏入了地下摔跤的擂台。

她怀着忐忑的心情，等待首场比赛的到来，
却发现自己的对手，正是两年前曾经交过手的那个女孩——
当时，她被对方击倒，输掉了比赛。

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE264204.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
